units.description: Master orthographic recognition, acoustic discrimination, and precise oral articulation for: Pre-A1 Literacy & Survival Capstone.
units.primaryGrammarTopic: Comprehensive review of Cyrillic literacy, spelling, numbers, and basic interaction

lessons.title: Systematic Alphabet Audit: Staged Grapheme Decoding & Rapid Identification
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Identify, name, and transcribe every uppercase and lowercase Cyrillic character without hesitation.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Conduct a structured diagnostic review of the 35 Cyrillic characters organized into three distinct structural cohorts: shared glyphs, distinct vowels, and palatalized/compound signs.
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Identify, name, and transcribe every uppercase and lowercase Cyrillic character without hesitation.
lessons.audioPurpose: Authentic native recitation of the official Cyrillic alphabet song/sequence.

grammarOverview.summary: Conduct a structured diagnostic review of the 35 Cyrillic characters organized into three distinct structural cohorts: shared glyphs, distinct vowels, and palatalized/compound signs.

lessons.title: Virtual Walking Tour of Ulaanbaatar: Reading Commercial Signage
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Read and identify commercial establishments (супермаркет, номын дэлгүүр, цайны газар, үсчин, эмийн сан).
lessons.primaryPurpose: Simulate a walking tour along Peace Avenue (Энхтайваны өргөн чөлөө), decoding authentic street-level signage.
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Read and identify commercial establishments (супермаркет, номын дэлгүүр, цайны газар, үсчин, эмийн сан).
lessons.audioPurpose: Authentic ambient street audio paired with sign descriptions.

grammarOverview.summary: Simulate a walking tour along Peace Avenue (Энхтайваны өргөн чөлөө), decoding authentic street-level signage.

lessons.title: Decoding Authentic Ephemera: Bus Cards, Receipts & Price Tags
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Extract total cost, date, item names, and transaction numbers from authentic Mongolian receipts and tickets.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Decode authentic printed ephemera: U-Money transit receipts, supermarket cash register receipts (НӨАТ), and price stickers.
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Extract total cost, date, item names, and transaction numbers from authentic Mongolian receipts and tickets.
lessons.audioPurpose: Cashier voice prompts reading totals at the register.

grammarOverview.summary: Decode authentic printed ephemera: U-Money transit receipts, supermarket cash register receipts (НӨАТ), and price stickers.

lessons.title: Digital Communication & Social Profile Setup in Cyrillic
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Complete an online profile bio (name, nationality, occupation) and type greeting messages via smartphone interface.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Set up a complete digital user profile and compose a 3-turn introductory chat message in Mongolian Cyrillic.
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Complete an online profile bio (name, nationality, occupation) and type greeting messages via smartphone interface.
lessons.audioPurpose: Incoming message audio chime paired with text-to-speech message playback.

grammarOverview.summary: Set up a complete digital user profile and compose a 3-turn introductory chat message in Mongolian Cyrillic.

lessons.title: Pre-A1 Integrated Environmental Literacy Benchmark Exam
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Demonstrate verified Pre-A1 environmental literacy competence across all 15 foundational literacy domains.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Administer the Pre-A1 literacy and survival capstone examination, assessing core Cyrillic decoding, vowel length discrimination, numbers 0-10, and formulaic greeting reception.
lessons.communicativeOutcome: Demonstrate verified Pre-A1 environmental literacy competence across all 15 foundational literacy domains.
lessons.audioPurpose: Standardized institutional exam audio recordings.

grammarOverview.summary: Administer the Pre-A1 literacy and survival capstone examination, assessing core Cyrillic decoding, vowel length discrimination, numbers 0-10, and formulaic greeting reception.
keyPoints: Administer the Pre-A1 literacy and survival capstone examination, assessing core Cyrillic decoding, vowel length discrimination, numbers 0-10, and formulaic greeting reception.

lessons.title: Pre-A1 Graduation & The Bridge to Sentence Construction
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Confidently recite one's achievements in Mongolian literacy and state personal learning goals for CEFR A1.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Consolidate literacy achievements, celebrate script mastery, and preview the transition into nominal sentences in A1 Unit 16.
